messages:
Alex: CI is red on linux-integration shard 12 for //pkg/ingest:ingest_test. Started after the toolchain/image roll earlier today. Anyone seen this?
Mira: can you paste the failing log? failing test name? flaky or real compile error?
Alex: test is failing during build step, looks like a genrule output path escape issue. log excerpt:```
ERROR: /workspace/pkg/ingest/BUILD:42:17: output 'bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/pkg/ingest/_gen/../some dir/ingest_gen.cc' was not created
Target //pkg/ingest:ingest_gen failed to build
INFO: Elapsed time: 12.34s, Critical Path: 2.56s
```
Thomas: hmm looks like spaces in genrule output path are not being quoted properly after the new sandbox/toolchain image. Could be the toolchain's tar/untar behavior changed.
CI-bot: buildkite: shard=linux-integration-12, status=FAIL, invocation=inv_2026_03_17_10_12_03
Kelsey: I hit a similar on a local mac cross-compile after that image bump. Quick workaround: change genrule to use $(location :outdir) sanitized or avoid spaces by using $(RULEDIR)/out instead of joining with repo_root.
Mira: can you try a quick patch to normalize the genrule output path (replace spaces with underscores) and request a rerun? If it goes green we can bisect the image roll.
Alex: pushing a small patch now to normalize path in //pkg/ingest:genrule_build. pinging CI rerun.
Alex: @CI-bot can you rerun linux-integration shard 12 for this commit?
CI-bot: buildkite: rerun requested by Alex, queueing shard linux-integration-12
Thomas: if rerun fails we should request a fast bisect across the toolchain/image roll. Prefer to bisect to the specific image that introduced different tar flags.
Kelsey: adding a debug flag to the genrule to print the expanded output path may help prove it's the quoting. small snippet:```bash
echo "GEN_OUT=\"$(@)\""
```
Alex: rerun completed — still failing but different error: now it complains about missing header during link. attaching new log.
Mira: ok that's interesting — the sanitized path avoided the output creation error but exposed a follow-on. deferring to Thomas for bisect?
Thomas: I'll start a bisect across the last 5 image rolls and tag infra. Can someone file a quick bug with repro steps and the two failing logs? I'll include the bisect job.
Kelsey: filed BUG-3482 with logs and repro steps. link: https://redwood.internal/bugs/3482 :thumbsup:
Alex: thanks all — keeping this thread updated with bisect results.
Kelsey: also added a short note in the PR description to avoid using spaces in generated output paths; probably worth a lint check later.
Thomas: bisect started (invocations queued). will post results here when done.
CI-bot: buildkite: bisect job queued inv_bisect_2991234600
Alex: thanks — assigning followups in the bug.
